title: Replication of Phases XXXIX-XLI-R on an open implementation
statusNote: Replication arm on an open implementation. The graph and classifier are the replication's own and are not the original Phase XXXIV-XLI-R implementation.

graph.construction: canonical N0 Numogram matrix restricted to Z0-Z8 (zone 9 deferred), plus the minimal arcs needed to meet the recorded degree sequence

transitionRule.formula: P(j|i) proportional to w_ij * (1 + m_j) * (1 + s * [j in hinge])

pfmInputs.selfLoopDepth: fraction of the previous 20 steps on which the stratum did not change (stratum-level self-loop depth)
pfmInputs.ringSignal: 1 if the step enters zone 0 from another zone, else 0
pfmInputs.corridorSignal: 1 if the step enters the hinge stratum from outside it, else 0
pfmInputs.latentSignal: 1 if the step traverses the manipulated arc 3->2, else 0
pfmInputs.releaseSignal: 1 if the step leaves the hinge stratum for the return stratum, else 0
pfmInputs.transitionSuccess: true if the stratum changed on this step

classifier.nullDistribution: stationary distribution of the unbiased random walk on the graph (all arc weights 1)
classifier.enrichment: e_g = occ_g / pi_g for each stratum g over the full cycle
classifier.assignment: region of the stratum with the largest enrichment
classifier.recaptureEvent: assignment = bifurcation-dissolution in a run whose probe targets hinge-stratum

metrics.recaptureScore: occupancy of the return stratum over the second half of the cycle (lower = less pull)
metrics.morphogeneticTransitionScore: fraction of transitions whose source or target is in the hinge stratum
metrics.gammaTrajectory: compare hinge occupancy in the final third with the first third: increase > 0.02 directional; |change| <= 0.02 stabilized; decrease > 0.02 oscillatory

runs.order: all runs in a phase executed in an order shuffled by a fixed PRNG seed 7

R-XXXIX.success: assignment = hinge-stratum; report access rate per condition and overall

R-XL.coefficientSensitivity: Spearman correlation of hingeOccupancy with c across low/knee/high runs; sensitive if rho > 0 with p < 0.05
R-XL.nonCircularity: passes if the untargeted control's hinge-stratum rate is lower than the knee condition's (Fisher exact, p < 0.05)

R-XLI.knee: coefficient of maximum discrete curvature of the mean composite curve (second difference), excluding endpoints

R-XLI-R.coefficientNote: the nine original XLI-R coefficients; the last is the recovery position
R-XLI-R.plateau: at least 4 consecutive coefficients (ordered by c, P1-P8) whose mean composite scores span <= 0.005 and whose fitted slope has a 95% bootstrap interval containing 0
R-XLI-R.thresholds: from calibration seeds 1-10 pooled across the nine coefficients: 5th percentile for fieldConfidence, hingeOccupancy, morphogeneticTransitionScore, boundaryMargin; 95th percentile for recaptureScore
R-XLI-R.validation: apply thresholds to held-out seeds 11-20; report the proportion of runs meeting all five

reportingCommitment: All outcomes are reported, including failure to replicate any original finding.
